content: Recruiters spend 2-5 minutes (often much less per case study) skimming portfolios. Top mistakes: opening a case study with the polished final UI instead of the problem/context; no stated role/goal/outcome up front forcing the reader to hunt; including every project rather than a curated few, diluting signal; poor navigation forcing digging to find relevant work; broken links/slow load/poor mobile responsiveness costing credibility instantly.
